Here are the growing conditions for Southern Cordyline (Cordyline australis) seeds:

• **Temperature:** 18-24°C
• **Hydrometry:** 60-70%
• **Sunshine:** 60-80%
• **Rainfall:** 800-1200mm
• **Humidity:** 50-70%
• **Soil:** Sandy loam
